featured_reviews.name: Yogya Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a truly wonderful experience at Essence Beauty Parlour run by my dear friend Swati! 🌸

From the moment you step in, you’re welcomed into a space that’s clean, hygienic, and filled with positive vibes. Swati’s professionalism, attention to detail, and passion for beauty services truly reflect in every treatment she offers.

I personally tried the Nanoplastia Hair Treatment – and wow, the results were amazing! My hair felt silky, shiny, and frizz-free without any damage. 💇‍♀️

Her makeup and hairstyling skills are equally top-notch – perfect for any occasion, be it bridal, parties, or casual events. 💄✨
And if you’re into nail art, she’s got you covered with trendy, elegant designs that last and look beautiful! The best part? Everything is done at very reasonable rates without compromising on quality or service.
Overall, I highly recommend Essence Beauty Parlour for anyone looking for a trustworthy, clean, and skilled beauty service provider. Swati truly puts her heart into her work — and it shows! 🌟

Give it a try — you’ll walk out glowing and smiling! 😊
